body:
### Summary

Since 0.12.14, uv pip install --target=. fails for every wheel that contains a directory entry, which is most of them. 0.12.13 and earlier install fine.

Behaviour comes from [#21569](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21569) ("Reject symlinked wheel installation destinations", labelled internal). Same PR caused #21692.

If it's an expected behavior change I would have expected that . gets rejected during argument parsing rather than after having downloaded the packages.

**Reproducer**
```
$ cd "$(mktemp -d)";uvx uv@0.12.14 pip install --python python3.14 --system --no-compile --no-cache --target=. annotated-types==0.8.0
Using CPython 3.14.4 interpreter at: /usr/bin/python3.14
Resolved 1 package in 147ms
Prepared 1 package in 15ms
error: Failed to install: annotated_types-0.8.0-py3-none-any.whl (annotated-types==0.8.0)
  cause: The wheel is invalid: Wheel directory entry escapes its destination: annotated_types-0.8.0.dist-info
```

**Before**
```
cd "$(mktemp -d)";uvx uv@0.12.13 pip install --python python3.14 --system --no-compile --no-cache --target=. annotated-types==0.8.0
Using CPython 3.14.4 interpreter at: /usr/bin/python3.14
Resolved 1 package in 112ms
Prepared 1 package in 15ms
Installed 1 package in 2ms
 + annotated-types==0.8.0
```

**Details**
The package is not special. pydantic fails on annotated-types first, types-boto3 on types-boto3-ec2.

Only the literal "." is affected. Every other destination installs, relative or absolute:

```
--target=.                    fails
--target=./                   fails
--target=packages             ok
--target=/tmp/xyz/packages    ok
--target=$PWD         ok
```



### Platform

Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, Linux 7.0.0-30-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.12.14

### Python version

_No response_
title: 0.12.14: `uv pip install --target=.` fails for every wheel with "The wheel is invalid: Wheel directory entry escapes its destination"
